about:
Atrium Corporation, based in Johnstown, Ohio, was established in 1996. The company functions as a private-label apparel and accessory manufacturer, delivering customized services that span from initial concept through to the final consumer. No information about ownership structure or founders is provided in the available sources.

Atrium's service portfolio includes full-service merchandising, product development, manufacturing, and business-to-business distribution with retail-ready capabilities. The firm manages the complete product lifecycle for private-label apparel and accessories, though details such as facility square footage, employee count, or annual production volumes are not disclosed.

The company targets brands and retailers within the apparel and accessories industries, offering both wholesale distribution and retail-ready programs. Specific client names or industry verticals beyond apparel and accessories are not identified in the source material.

Atrium positions its end-to-end model—covering design, development, production, and distribution—as its core differentiator, enabling clients to consolidate their supply chain. The company does not articulate a specific founding mission or unique origin story beyond this comprehensive service approach.
